entries.title: Psalms 136:1
segments:
The present psalm is peculiar in its structure, the last half of each verse consisting of the burden of refrain, "for his mercy endureth for ever." 
 
"God is love."  All his acts are done in mercy and loving-kindness; and they all work together for the good of those who love him.

entries.title: Psalms 136:15
segments: God's mercy insures the overthrow of his enemies, not less than the salvation of his friends.

entries.title: Psalms 136:23
segments: In our low estate; when we were captives in Babylon.

entries.title: Psalms 136:24
segments: From our enemies; from those who carried us captive.
